title: GhostMode
description: Privacy mod to hide unwanted things for content creators
body:
# GhostMode

A client-side privacy mod built for streamers and content creators. Keep your personal info off screen while you play — no more accidentally flashing your server IP or real username on stream.

Everything is off by default. Turn on only what you need.

---

## Features

### 🔒 IP Masking
Hides your server IP on the Add Server and Direct Connect screens. Shows dots instead of your real address — click the padlock icon to reveal it when you need to.

### 👤 Username Alias
Replaces your real Minecraft username with a custom alias everywhere on screen — chat, tab list, F3, you name it. Your viewers never see your actual IGN.

### 🗺️ F3 Filter
Selectively hide parts of the F3 debug screen. Toggle off location, biome, "looking at", memory usage, and system specs independently — show only what you're comfortable with.

### 📍 Fake Coords
Replaces your real XYZ coordinates in F3 with randomised numbers that change on a configurable interval. Keeps your base location private without turning off F3 entirely.

### 📋 Tab List Control
Hide the tab list entirely, show only the player count, or display a fake ping value for your own entry.

### 💧 Watermark
Show your channel name or any custom text on screen while you stream. Configurable position (corners or action bar), color, and opacity.

---

## Config

Press **J** (rebindable) to open the config screen in-game, or access it via ModMenu.

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API 0.141.4+1.21.11
- [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) 3.8.2+1.21.11-fabric
- [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) 17.0.0 (optional)

---

*Client-side only — works on any server.*
